key_insight: Posterior sampling can be improved by automatically tuning time-dependent guidance weights, turning heuristic balancing into a small offline least-squares problem.
engineering_relevance: This gives a training-free way to boost inverse-problem reconstruction quality and cut diffusion sampling steps dramatically without retraining the generative model.
method: Express conditional prediction as a weighted sum of the unconditional network output and a measurement-guidance term.
At each time step, solve a 2D linear least-squares problem to optimize the guidance weights offline.
Use a single minibatch of sampling trajectories for a fixed measurement operator, noise level, and sampler.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art reconstruction performance across diffusion- and flow-matching-based methods, and diffusion samplers reduced from 1000 to 50 steps with no significant quality loss.
watch_item: The tuned weights are specific to the measurement operator, noise level, and sampler, so they may need recomputation when the inverse-problem setting changes.
paper_title: Getting Your Guidance Weights Right in diffusion and flow-matching posterior sampling
